text:
incident-bot: Paging alert — elevated 5xx observed for /v1/embeddings in us-east-1 between 12:03–12:07 UTC. On-call: sam. Channel created for mitigation.

sam (oncall): I'm on it. Joining bridge and pulling node logs now. Will post a short timeline.

rashid (eng-sre): Looks like embeddings-optim v2.2 kernel selection fallback triggered OOM on a subset of nodes after the 11:59 deploy. Reproducing locally.

sam (oncall): Rolled back embeddings-optim -> v2.1 at 12:05 UTC, rollback finished 12:06. Error rate back to baseline by 12:08.

rashid (eng-sre): Confirmed: rollback removed regression. Mitigation: temporary pin to v2.1 on dedicated pools until patch. No data exfiltration.

eva (cs): Noted. @maria impacted customers list? Estimate of scope?

maria (acct-mgr): Need list of tenants and failure counts before we notify. Also confirm whether this qualifies for SLA credit.

rashid (eng-sre): Affected: subset of dedicated pools in us-east-1. Failure rate ~0.6% of embedding requests during window; retries increased latency for ~1.1%. Preparing per-tenant CSV and logs now.

sam (oncall): Drafting status page note. Posting suggestion below — please review.

sam (oncall): ```
Status page (public):
- Incident: Elevated 5xx for Embeddings API (us-east-1)
- Start: 2026-03-16 12:03 UTC
- Resolved: 2026-03-16 12:08 UTC
- Impact: Transient failures for ~0.6% of embedding requests; some requests retried/experienced increased latency.
- Customer action: Automatic retries in SDKs should have mitigated most failures; no action required.
- Next steps: RCA and mitigation timeline to follow.
```

eva (cs): OK. Here's a short customer-facing note for affected accounts — please edit as needed:```
Hi — we detected a short disruption affecting the Embeddings API in US-EAST on 2026-03-16 between 12:03–12:08 UTC. Some requests returned errors or experienced higher latency; most SDKs retried successfully. We have rolled back the recent runtime change and service is operating normally. We will follow up with an RCA and any applicable account credits. Sorry for the impact — reach out to cs+{account} if you need more details.
```

maria (acct-mgr): LGTM. Please add: "We will apply a one-time billing credit for affected usage during the incident window." Also include timeline and link to status page.

rashid (eng-sre): Action items: 1) Full RCA with kernel-selection trace + logs (24h) 2) Fix PR for kernel selection regression + test (incoming in 12h) 3) Add canary guard to rollout pipeline (72h). I'll attach artifact links here when ready.

sam (oncall): CS action items: 1) Send targeted email to affected tenants (4h) 2) Track replies/upsell risk 3) Confirm credits applied. I'll coordinate.

eva (cs): I'll prepare the customer emails and include the CSV from rashid. Will use the copy above and the credit wording from @maria.

sam (oncall): Will file the incident ticket for formal RCA and mark followups. Please add comments to ticket: RCA due + mitigation ETA.

incident-bot: Incident closed — all systems nominal. Tags: routing, kernel-selection, embeddings.

maria (acct-mgr): Thanks all. Please DM me the tenant CSV when available so I can approve credits. :thumbsup:

sam (oncall): Closing thread here once RCA linked to the ticket. Good catch and quick rollback everyone. :white_check_mark:
